verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents converting files into a consistent, contextualized JSON of document elements and metadata, which it calls "AI-ready" and RAG-ready. That covers the structured-output half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows markdown output or the stripping of repeated headers, footers, and other page furniture. Missing for 10: documented markdown output, documented removal of headers/footers/page furniture, independent or hands-on corroboration of output cleanliness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I get clean markdown/JSON designed for LLM consumption, with noise like repeated headers and page furniture stripped

citations.quote: Partitioning converts content from unstructured files and semi-structured data records into structured document elements and metadata in a predefined, consistent, expressive, and contextualized JSON format.
Create a job to partition, chunk, and embed local files into AI-ready JSON with vector embeddings for semantic search.
Use Python or cURL to turn local files into AI-ready JSON.
